title: Compare two coordinate reference systems without PROJ — geo_crs_equal
text: "identical": absent, string byte byte, PROJJSON object ignoring key order. zugeo's checks use level. "structural": PROJJSON compared dropping members change coordinates ($schema, name, remarks, usages, scope, area, bbox) treating integers doubles alike. string CRS identical gives NA. "authority": authority code, AUTHORITY:CODE string PROJJSON id, authority's case ignored pairs differ axis order (OGC:CRS84 EPSG:4326) treated one. side authority code gives NA. NA means zugeo tell without PROJ, never two differ.
